newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson, Electrolux help push Swedish shares down.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson, Electrolux help push Swedish shares down.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Tuesday, partly depressed by falls in telecoms group Ericsson and appliance maker Electrolux.
The bourse's general index fell 0.60 percent to 2,901.76 in turnover of 4.42 billion crowns.
Ericsson dropped six crowns to 296 after news about a merger between the consumer communications product businesses of Lucent and Philips caused market players to fear increased competition.
"There are worries that the new large group will create tougher competition," a trader said.
Electrolux fell 25 crowns to 557 on profit taking after rocketing late last week on its restructuring plans.
Fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz was also stung by profit taking and slipped 3.5 crowns to 282 after leaping 26 crowns on Monday on higher-than-expected six-month earnings.
The forestry sector bucked negative trends and rose 1.34 percent, largely lifted by gains for Stora which advanced 3.5 crowns to 124.
The drugs sector rose 1.06 percent with Astra rising one crown to 131 and Pharmacia & Upjohn gaining four crowns to 265.
